translations.literal: Shizong once told the chief ministers: "Outstanding talent among Jurchen jinshi is hard to come by; men like Tudan Yi, Jiagu Heng, and Nipanggu Jian are all useful material.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong once told his chief ministers, "Truly outstanding men among the Jurchen jinshi are hard to find, but men like Tudan Yi, Jiagu Heng, and Nipanggu Jian are all useful talent.

sentences.zh: 」遷修起居注。

translations.literal: " He was transferred to Compiler of the Diary of Activity and Repose.
translations.idiomatic: " He was transferred to compiler of the Diary of Activity and Repose.

sentences.zh: 章宗立，為侍御史，轉右司員外郎，敷奏稱旨，升左司郎中。

translations.literal: When Zhangzong ascended the throne, he became Attending Censor, then transferred to Assistant Director of the Right Department; his memorials pleased the throne, and he was promoted to Director of the Left Department.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhangzong took the throne, he became Attending Censor, then was transferred to Assistant Director of the Right Department. His memorials pleased the throne, and he was promoted to Director of the Left Department.

sentences.zh: 明昌二年，擢御史中丞，未幾，拜參知政事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Mingchang he was elevated to Vice Censor-in-Chief; before long he was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Mingchang he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief, and before long was appointed Vice Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，以病，表乞致仕，詔撫慰不許。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year, on account of illness he submitted a memorial requesting retirement; an edict comforted him and refused.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year he submitted a memorial asking to retire on account of illness. An edict comforted him and refused the request.

sentences.zh: 衡久在告，承詔始出，上見其羸瘠，複賜告一月。

translations.literal: Heng had long been on sick leave; only when he received the edict did he come out. The emperor, seeing him emaciated, again granted him one month's leave.
translations.idiomatic: Heng had long been on sick leave and came out only when he received the edict. Seeing how wasted he was, the emperor granted him another month of leave.

sentences.zh: 四年，詔賜今名，諭之曰：「朕選大臣，俾參機務，必資謀畫，協贊治平。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, an edict granted him his present name and addressed him: "When I select great ministers to join in state affairs, I rely on their counsel and planning to assist in achieving good governance.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year an edict granted him his present name and addressed him: "When I choose great ministers to share in state affairs, I rely on their counsel and planning to help bring about good order.

sentences.zh: 其或得失晦而未形，利害膠而未決，正須識見純直，方能去取合公。

translations.literal: When gains and losses remain hidden and not yet apparent, or benefits and harms stick together unresolved, what is needed is pure, upright judgment—only then can choices and rejections accord with the public good.
translations.idiomatic: When gains and losses are still obscure and benefits and harms remain entangled and unresolved, what is needed is pure, upright judgment—only then can one choose and reject in the public interest.

sentences.zh: 比來議事之臣，鮮有一定之論，蓋以內無所守，故臨事而惑，致有中失，朕將何賴？

translations.literal: Recently ministers who discuss affairs rarely hold firm views, mostly because they have no inner convictions; hence they waver when matters arise, leading to errors midway—whom shall I rely on?
translations.idiomatic: Of late the ministers who debate affairs rarely hold to a settled view, mostly because they have no inner convictions. When matters arise they grow confused, and errors follow midway. Whom then can I rely on?

sentences.zh: 卿忠實公方，審其是則執而不回，見其非則去而能果，度其事勢，有若權衡。

translations.literal: You are loyal, sincere, and upright; when you discern what is right you hold to it without turning back; when you see what is wrong you withdraw and can be resolute; gauging the force of affairs, you are like a balance scale.
translations.idiomatic: You are loyal, sincere, and upright. When you see what is right you hold to it without turning back; when you see what is wrong you withdraw and can be resolute. In weighing the force of affairs you are like a balance scale.

sentences.zh: 汝之所長，衡實似之，可賜名衡。

translations.literal: What you excel at—the meaning of 'heng' truly resembles it—you may be granted the name Heng.
translations.idiomatic: What you excel at, the word heng truly resembles; you may be granted the name Heng.

sentences.zh: 古者命名，將以責實，汝先有實，可謂稱名，行之克終，乃副朕意。」

translations.literal: In antiquity names were given to demand reality from the bearer; you already have the reality, which may be said to fit the name—carry it through to the end, and you will fulfill my intent."
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity names were given to demand reality from the bearer. You already have the reality, and so the name fits. Carry it through to the end, and you will fulfill my intent."

sentences.zh: 參知政事胥持國言區種法。

translations.literal: Vice Grand Councilor Xu Chiguo spoke of the plot-cultivation method.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Grand Councilor Xu Chiguo advocated the plot-cultivation method.

sentences.zh: 衡曰：「若苟有利，古已行之，且用功多而所種少，複恐荒廢土田，徒勞民，無益也。

translations.literal: Heng said: "If it were merely profitable, the ancients would already have practiced it. Moreover, it requires much labor for little planted area; I also fear wasteland would be abandoned and the people would toil in vain without benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Heng said, "If it were truly profitable, the ancients would already have practiced it. Moreover, it demands much labor for little planted ground, and I fear good farmland would be left idle while the people toiled in vain to no benefit.

sentences.zh: 」進尚書右丞。

translations.literal: " He was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " He was promoted to Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 舊制，久曆隨朝職任者，得奉使江表。

translations.literal: Under the old system, those who had long served in court posts could be sent on missions to the Jiang region.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system, officials who had long served at court were entitled to be sent on missions south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 衡未使而拜執政，特賜錢六千貫。

translations.literal: Heng had not yet served on such a mission when he was appointed to the council; he was specially granted six thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: Heng had not yet gone on such a mission when he was appointed to the council, so he was specially granted six thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 六年，遷尚書左丞，尋出行省於撫州。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was transferred to Left Vice Director; soon he went out as regional commissioner at Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he was transferred to Left Vice Director, and soon went out as regional commissioner at Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 洎還入朝，聞父憂去，上亟召回，起複本職。

translations.literal: When he returned to court, he heard of his father's death and left office; the emperor urgently recalled him and had him resume his former post from mourning.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned to court and heard of his father's death, he left office. The emperor urgently recalled him and had him resume his former post from mourning.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，出為上京留守，尋改樞密副使，行院規畫邊事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an he went out as Intendant of Shangjing; soon he was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, directing frontier affairs from the bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an he went out as Intendant of Shangjing, and soon was changed to Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, where he planned frontier affairs.

sentences.zh: 三年，以修完封界，賜詔褒諭。

translations.literal: In the third year, for completing and repairing the border demarcations, he was granted an edict of commendation.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, for completing and repairing the border demarcations, he received an edict of commendation.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，就拜平章政事，封英國公。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year he was appointed Grand Chancellor on the spot and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year he was appointed Grand Chancellor on the spot and enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 薨，年五十一。

translations.literal: He died, aged fifty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died, aged fifty-one.

sentences.zh: 上聞之惻然，為輟朝，命官致祭，賻贈有加。

translations.literal: The emperor, hearing of it, was deeply moved; court was suspended on his account; officials were ordered to perform the sacrifice; funeral gifts were especially generous.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, hearing of it, was deeply moved and suspended court on his account. Officials were ordered to perform the sacrifices, and funeral gifts were especially generous.

sentences.zh: 遣使敕葬，諡曰貞獻。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched with orders governing the burial; posthumous title: Zhenxian.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched with orders governing the burial. He was given the posthumous title Zhenxian.

sentences.zh: 完顏安國

translations.literal: Wanyan Anguo
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Anguo

sentences.zh: 完顏安國，字正臣，本名闍母。

translations.literal: Wanyan Anguo, courtesy name Zhengchen, original name Shemu.
translations.idiomatic: Wanyan Anguo, courtesy name Zhengchen, whose original name was Shemu.

sentences.zh: 其先占籍上京，世有戰功。

translations.literal: His ancestors were registered in Shangjing; the family had military merit for generations.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestors were registered in Shangjing, and the family had won military distinction for generations.

sentences.zh: 祖斜婆，授西南路世襲合劄謀克。

translations.literal: His grandfather Xiepo was granted the hereditary hezha baimouke of the Southwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Xiepo was granted the hereditary hezha baimouke of the Southwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 安國沉雄有謀畫，尤善騎射。

translations.literal: Anguo was deep and bold, skilled in planning, and especially adept at horsemanship and archery.
translations.idiomatic: Anguo was grave and resolute, skilled in planning, and especially adept at horsemanship and archery.

sentences.zh: 正隆元年，從軍為謀克，常以少擊眾。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenglong he followed the army as baimouke and often struck with few against many.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhenglong he entered military service as baimouke and often fought with few against many.

sentences.zh: 大定中，為常山簿，轉虹縣令。

translations.literal: During Dading he served as Changshan assistant magistrate, then transferred to magistrate of Hong County.
translations.idiomatic: During Dading he served as assistant magistrate of Changshan, then was transferred to magistrate of Hong County.

sentences.zh: 會王府新建，選充虞王府掾。

translations.literal: When the princely establishment was newly built, he was selected as clerk to the Prince of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: When the princely establishment was newly built, he was selected as a clerk in the household of the Prince of Yu.

sentences.zh: 再遷儀鸞局副使。

translations.literal: He was twice promoted, to Deputy Commissioner of the Ceremonial Guard Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to Deputy Commissioner of the Ceremonial Guard Bureau.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年，改本局使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Mingchang he was changed to Commissioner of that bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Mingchang he was made Commissioner of that bureau.

sentences.zh: 會大石部長有乞修歲貢者，朝廷許其請，詔安國往使之。

translations.literal: When a chief of Dashi's tribe requested restoration of the annual tribute, the court granted the request and ordered Anguo to go as envoy.
translations.idiomatic: When a chief of Dashi's tribe asked that the annual tribute be restored, the court granted the request and ordered Anguo to go as envoy.

sentences.zh: 至則率眾遠迓至帳，望闕羅拜，執禮無惰容。

translations.literal: On his arrival, the chief led his people out to receive him from afar to the tent; facing the imperial palace direction they kowtowed in rows, observing the rites without slackness.
translations.idiomatic: On Anguo's arrival the chief led his people far out to meet him and escorted him to the tent. Facing the direction of the imperial court they kowtowed in rows, observing the rites without the least slackness.

sentences.zh: 時北阻珝迫近塞垣，鄰部欲立功以誇雄上國，議邀安國俱行討之。

translations.literal: At the time Beizu Xu in the north pressed close to the frontier; a neighboring tribe wished to win merit and boast its prowess to the great state, and proposed inviting Anguo to join them in a punitive expedition.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Beizu Xu in the north pressed close to the frontier. A neighboring tribe wished to win merit and show its prowess to the great state, and proposed that Anguo join them in a punitive expedition.

sentences.zh: 安國以未奉詔為辭。

translations.literal: Anguo declined on the grounds that he had received no imperial order.
translations.idiomatic: Anguo declined on the grounds that he had received no imperial order.

sentences.zh: 強之，不可。

translations.literal: They pressed him; he would not yield.
translations.idiomatic: They pressed him, but he would not yield.

sentences.zh: 或以危言怵之，安國曰：「大丈夫豈以生死易節。

translations.literal: Some tried to frighten him with dire threats. Anguo said: "Would a true man exchange his integrity for life or death?
translations.idiomatic: Some tried to frighten him with dire threats. Anguo said, "Would a true man exchange his integrity for life or death?

sentences.zh: 暴骨邊庭，不猶愈於病死牖下。

translations.literal: To leave one's bones exposed on the frontier—is that not still better than dying of illness beneath one's window?
translations.idiomatic: To leave one's bones on the frontier—is that not still better than dying of illness beneath one's own window?

sentences.zh: 」眾壯其言，饋贐如禮。

translations.literal: " The assembly admired his words and sent him off with gifts according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " The assembly admired his words and sent him off with parting gifts according to ritual.

sentences.zh: 既還，以奉使稱旨，升武衛軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On his return, because his mission pleased the throne, he was promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Martial Guard Army.
translations.idiomatic: On his return, because his mission had pleased the throne, he was promoted to Commander-in-Chief of the Martial Guard Army.

sentences.zh: 出為東北路副招討，未赴，改西北路副招討。

translations.literal: He went out as Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northeast Circuit; before he took up the post he was changed to Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was sent out as Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northeast Circuit, but before he took up the post was reassigned as Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 六年，左丞相夾谷清臣用兵，以安國為先鋒都統。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when Left Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen took the field, Anguo was made Vanguard Commander-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Left Chancellor Jiagu Qingchen took the field, Anguo was made Vanguard Commander-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 適臨潢、泰州屬部叛，安國先討定之，以功遷本路招討使，兼威遠軍節度使。

translations.literal: Just then dependent tribes of Linhuang and Taizhou rebelled; Anguo first suppressed and settled them, and for his merit was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of that circuit, concurrently Military Commissioner of the Weiyuan Army.
translations.idiomatic: Just then dependent tribes under Linhuang and Taizhou rebelled. Anguo suppressed them first and, for his merit, was transferred to Pacification Commissioner of that circuit, concurrently Military Commissioner of the Weiyuan Army.

sentences.zh: 承安元年，大鹽濼之戰，殺獲甚眾，詔賜金幣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Cheng'an, at the battle of Great Salt Marsh, he killed and captured in great numbers; an edict granted gold and silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Cheng'an, at the battle of Great Salt Marsh, he killed and captured in great numbers, and an edict granted him gold and silks.

sentences.zh: 既而右丞相襄總大軍進，安國為兩路都統，大捷於多泉子。

translations.literal: Before long Right Chancellor Xiang commanded the main army forward; Anguo served as Commander-in-Chief of both circuits and won a great victory at Duoquanzi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Right Chancellor Xiang led the main army forward. Anguo served as Commander-in-Chief of both circuits and won a great victory at Duoquanzi.

sentences.zh: 襄遣安國追敵，僉言糧道繼，不可行也。

translations.literal: Xiang sent Anguo to pursue the enemy; all said supplies would not keep up and the move was impracticable.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang sent Anguo to pursue the enemy, but all said the supply lines would not keep up and the move was impracticable.

sentences.zh: 安國曰：「人得一羊可食十餘日，不如驅羊以襲之便。

translations.literal: Anguo said: "If each man takes one sheep he can eat for more than ten days—better to drive the sheep and strike while doing so.
translations.idiomatic: Anguo said, "If each man takes one sheep he can eat for more than ten days. Better to drive the sheep along and strike the enemy that way.

sentences.zh: 」遂從其計。

translations.literal: " They followed his plan.
translations.idiomatic: " They followed his plan.

sentences.zh: 安國統所部萬人疾驅以薄之，降其部長。

translations.literal: Anguo commanded ten thousand men of his command in a forced march to close with the enemy and received the surrender of their chief.
translations.idiomatic: Anguo led ten thousand men of his command in a forced march to close with the enemy and received the surrender of their chief.

sentences.zh: 捷聞，進官四級，遷左翼都統。

translations.literal: When news of the victory arrived, he was promoted four ranks and transferred to Commander-in-Chief of the Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: When news of the victory arrived, he was promoted four ranks and made Commander-in-Chief of the Left Wing.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，以營邊堡功，召簽樞密院事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an, for merits in building frontier fortresses, he was summoned to sign Bureau of Military Affairs documents.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an, for his merits in building frontier fortresses, he was summoned to sign Bureau of Military Affairs documents.

sentences.zh: 賜虎符還邊，得以便宜從事。

translations.literal: Granted a tiger tally and sent back to the frontier, he was empowered to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Granted a tiger tally and sent back to the frontier, he was empowered to act at his own discretion.

sentences.zh: 時並塞諸部降，諭使輸貢如初。

translations.literal: At the time all frontier tribes submitted; they were instructed to deliver tribute as before.
translations.idiomatic: At the time all the frontier tribes submitted, and they were instructed to deliver tribute as before.

sentences.zh: 進拜樞密副使。

translations.literal: He was further appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was further appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 泰和元年，特授世襲西南路延晏河猛安，兼合劄謀克。

translations.literal: In the first year of Taihe he was specially granted the hereditary meng'an of Yanyan River in the Southwest Circuit, concurrently hezha baimouke.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taihe he was specially granted the hereditary meng'an of Yanyan River in the Southwest Circuit, concurrently hezha baimouke.

sentences.zh: 帝幸慶甯宮，命安國嚴飭邊備。

translations.literal: When the emperor visited Qingning Palace, he ordered Anguo to tighten frontier defenses strictly.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor visited Qingning Palace, he ordered Anguo to tighten frontier defenses.

sentences.zh: 奏西南路邊戍私竄者乞招誘以安人心，上是其言。

translations.literal: He memorialized that those who had slipped across the border from the Southwest Circuit garrisons should be invited back to reassure the people; the emperor approved his view.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that those who had slipped away from the Southwest Circuit border garrisons should be invited back to reassure the people, and the emperor approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 三年，以疾致仕，封道國公。

translations.literal: In the third year he retired on account of illness and was enfeoffed as Duke of Daoguo.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he retired on account of illness and was enfeoffed as Duke of Daoguo.

sentences.zh: 四年，起複前職，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was recalled from retirement to his former post and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was recalled from retirement to his former post and died.

sentences.zh: 上聞之，輟朝。

translations.literal: The emperor, hearing of it, suspended court.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of it, he suspended court.

sentences.zh: 敕有司葬以執政禮。

translations.literal: He ordered the relevant offices to bury him with the rites due a councilor.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the relevant offices to bury him with the rites due a councilor.

sentences.zh: 贈特進。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Special Advancement.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the rank of Special Advancement.

sentences.zh: 安國在軍旅幾十五年，號令嚴明，指麾卒伍如左右手。

translations.literal: Anguo was in military service for nearly fifteen years; his orders were strict and clear, and he directed his troops as easily as his own hands.
translations.idiomatic: Anguo spent nearly fifteen years in military service. His orders were strict and clear, and he directed his troops as easily as his own hands.

sentences.zh: 又善伺知敵人虛實及山川險易，戰必身先士卒，故所向輒克。

translations.literal: He was also skilled at discerning the enemy's strength and weakness and the perils and ease of mountains and rivers; in battle he always led from the front, and therefore wherever he turned he prevailed.
translations.idiomatic: He was also skilled at reading the enemy's strength and weakness and the dangers and advantages of the terrain. In battle he always led from the front, and wherever he turned he prevailed.

sentences.zh: 諸部入貢，安國能一一呼其祖先弟侄名字以戒諭之，諸部皆震悚，甚為鄰國所畏服。

translations.literal: When the various tribes came to offer tribute, Anguo could call out each one's ancestors, younger brothers, and nephews by name to admonish and instruct them; all the tribes were awed and fearful, and neighboring states greatly feared and submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: When the tribes came to pay tribute, Anguo could call out each man's ancestors, brothers, and nephews by name to warn and instruct them. Every tribe was awestruck, and neighboring states held him in deep respect and fear.

sentences.zh: 瑤里孛迭

translations.literal: Yaoli Beidie
translations.idiomatic: Yaoli Beidie

sentences.zh: 瑤里孛迭，北京路窟白猛安陀羅山謀克人也。

translations.literal: Yaoli Beidie was a man of the Tuoluo Mountain meng'an in Kubai meng'an, Beijing Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Yaoli Beidie came from the Tuoluo Mountain meng'an in the Kubai meng'an district of the Beijing Circuit.

sentences.zh: 以軍功曆海濱令，遷徐王府掾。

translations.literal: For military merit he served successively as magistrate of Haibin and was transferred to clerk in the Prince of Xu's household.
translations.idiomatic: For his military service he rose through the post of magistrate of Haibin and was transferred to a clerkship in the household of the Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 以稱職，再任御史台。

translations.literal: Because he performed his duties well, he was again appointed to the Censorate.
translations.idiomatic: His competent performance won him a second appointment to the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 察廉，升同知震武軍節度使事。

translations.literal: On inspection for integrity he was promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Zhenwu Army Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: After an integrity inspection he was promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Zhenwu Army Military Commission.

sentences.zh: 明昌初，為唐州刺史，尋授西北路招討副使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Mingchang he was prefect of Tangzhou and shortly afterward appointed Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Mingchang he became prefect of Tangzhou, and soon afterward was made Deputy Pacification Commissioner of the Northwest Circuit.

sentences.zh: 未幾，改東北路。

translations.literal: Before long he was transferred to the Northeast Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was transferred to the Northeast Circuit.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，北邊有警，聚兵圍慶州急，孛迭率本路軍往救，敵解去，州竟無患。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year there was an alarm on the northern frontier; enemy forces gathered and pressed Qingzhou hard; Beidie led the troops of his circuit to rescue it, the enemy withdrew, and the prefecture was ultimately unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the sixth year the northern frontier was alarmed when enemy forces massed and pressed Qingzhou hard. Beidie led his circuit's army to the rescue, the enemy withdrew, and the prefecture escaped harm.

sentences.zh: 承安元年，丞相襄北伐，孛迭為先鋒副統，進軍至龍駒河，受圍，會襄引大軍至，得解。

translations.literal: In the first year of Cheng'an, Chancellor Xiang campaigned north; Beidie served as deputy vanguard commander, advanced to Longju River, was surrounded, but when Xiang brought the main army up he was relieved.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Cheng'an, when Chancellor Xiang marched north, Beidie served as deputy vanguard commander. He advanced to Longju River and was surrounded, but was relieved when Xiang brought up the main army.

sentences.zh: 後授鎮甯軍節度使，以六群牧人叛，改寧昌軍。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhenning Army; because the Six Herd-Pasturage peoples rebelled, he was changed to the Ningchang Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was later appointed Military Commissioner of the Zhenning Army, then transferred to the Ningchang Army when the Six Herd-Pasturage peoples rebelled.

sentences.zh: 孛迭為都統，領步騎萬次懿州，敵數萬來逆戰，兵勢甚張，孛迭親陷陣，奮力鏖擊卻之，身中二創，捷聞，遷一官。

translations.literal: Beidie as commander-in-chief led ten thousand infantry and cavalry to camp at Yizhou; several tens of thousands of the enemy came to give battle, their force very imposing; Beidie personally plunged into the formation, fought fiercely and drove them back, was wounded twice, news of victory arrived, and he was promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: As commander-in-chief Beidie led ten thousand foot and horse to Yizhou. Tens of thousands of the enemy came out to fight with imposing force. Beidie charged into the line himself, fought them off after a fierce struggle, and took two wounds. On report of victory he was promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 承安二年，颭軍千餘出沒剽掠錦、懿間，孛迭追敗之，複獲所掠，悉還本戶。

translations.literal: In the second year of Cheng'an, more than a thousand Khitan troops appeared and vanished raiding between Jin and Yi; Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered what had been plundered, and returned it all to the original households.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Cheng'an more than a thousand Khitan horsemen raided back and forth between Jin and Yi. Beidie pursued and defeated them, recovered the booty, and returned everything to the original households.

sentences.zh: 三年，從同判大睦親府事宗浩為左翼都統，戰移密河，勝；

translations.literal: In the third year he followed the Associate Director of the Great Mujin Office Zonghao as Left Wing commander-in-chief, fought at the Yimi River, and was victorious;
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Associate Director of the Great Mujin Office Zonghao as commander of the left wing, fought at the Yimi River, and won;

sentences.zh: 戰骨堡子西，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: fought west of Gubao Fort, killing and capturing a great many.
translations.idiomatic: then fought west of Gubao Fort, killing and capturing a great many.

sentences.zh: 五年，授知廣寧府事，俄改東北路招討使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed to administer Guangning Prefecture affairs and shortly changed to Northeast Circuit Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was put in charge of Guangning Prefecture and soon afterward made Northeast Circuit Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 以捍邊有功，賜詔褒諭，三遷為崇義軍節度使。

translations.literal: For merit in defending the frontier he was granted an edict of praise and instruction and was promoted three times to Military Commissioner of the Chongyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: For his service in defending the frontier he received an edict of commendation and was promoted three ranks to Military Commissioner of the Chongyi Army.

sentences.zh: 泰和六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Taihe he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the sixth year of Taihe.

sentences.zh: 訃聞，遣官致祭，賜銀五百兩，贈金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When news of his death arrived, officials were sent to perform sacrifices, five hundred taels of silver were granted, and he was posthumously given the title of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: On report of his death the court sent officials to perform sacrifices, granted five hundred taels of silver, and posthumously awarded him Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon.

sentences.zh: 孛迭勇決善戰，自幼以軍功顯，任兵鎮十餘年，所向克捷，凡再遷官，賜金幣，甚為上倚注雲。

translations.literal: Beidie was bold, resolute, and skilled in battle; from youth he distinguished himself through military merit; he held frontier military posts for more than ten years and wherever he went achieved victory; in all he was twice promoted in rank and granted gold and coin, and was greatly relied upon by the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Beidie was bold, resolute, and skilled in battle. He had distinguished himself by military merit from youth, held frontier commands for more than ten years, and won wherever he went. He was twice promoted and granted gold and coin, and the emperor relied on him heavily.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：《易·師》之初六：「師出以律，否臧凶。

translations.literal: The encomium says: In the first six of the Army hexagram in the Changes: "The army sets forth according to discipline; ill fortune and harm follow."
translations.idiomatic: The encomium says: In the first line of the Army hexagram in the Book of Changes: "An army sets forth only under discipline; without it, ill fortune and harm follow."

sentences.zh: 」蓋初為師之始，出師之道，當慎其始。

translations.literal: " For at the very beginning of becoming an army, the way of taking the field should be cautious at the outset.
translations.idiomatic: " At the very beginning of raising an army, the way one takes the field must be approached with caution from the start.

sentences.zh: 清臣首議出師，遽以貪小利敗。

translations.literal: Qingchen was first to propose taking the field and swiftly failed through greed for small gains.
translations.idiomatic: Qingchen was the first to urge a campaign and swiftly failed through greed for petty booty.

sentences.zh: 襄雖賢，竭力而後勝其任。

translations.literal: Though Xiang was worthy, only after exerting his utmost strength did he succeed in his charge.
translations.idiomatic: Though Xiang was capable, only after exhausting himself did he meet the demands of his post.

sentences.zh: 衡、安國、孛迭之功又亞於襄者也。

translations.literal: The achievements of Heng, Anguo, and Beidie were again inferior to Xiang's.
translations.idiomatic: The achievements of Heng, Anguo, and Beidie ranked still below Xiang's.

sentences.zh: 然而兵連禍結，以終金世。

translations.literal: Yet warfare linked disaster upon disaster until the Jin age ended.
translations.idiomatic: Yet war linked disaster to disaster until the Jin dynasty came to its end.

sentences.zh: 故兵無常勝，制勝在勢。

translations.literal: Therefore armies do not win constantly; mastery lies in strategic position.
translations.idiomatic: Thus armies do not win forever; victory depends on strategic position.

sentences.zh: 勢制兵者強，兵制勢者亡。

translations.literal: When position controls the army, one is strong; when the army controls position, one perishes.
translations.idiomatic: When strategic position controls the army, a state is strong; when the army tries to control position, it perishes.

sentences.zh: 跡襄之開築壕塹以自固，其猶元魏、北齊之長城歟？

translations.literal: Tracing Xiang's opening and building of moats and ramparts to secure himself—is it not like the Long Walls of Northern Wei and Northern Qi?
translations.idiomatic: Consider Xiang's digging of moats and ramparts to secure the realm—is this not like the long walls of Northern Wei and Northern Qi?

sentences.zh: 金之勢可知矣。

translations.literal: Jin's strategic position may thus be known.
translations.idiomatic: From this one can read the Jin dynasty's strategic position.

sentences.zh: 勢屈而兵勝，亡國之道也。

translations.literal: When position is bent while the army wins, that is the way of a perishing state.
translations.idiomatic: When strategic position weakens while armies still win battles, that is the path to national ruin.

sentences.zh: 金以兵始，亦以兵終。

translations.literal: Jin began with arms and also ended with arms.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin rose by the sword and fell by the sword.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼！

translations.literal: Alas!
translations.idiomatic: Alas!

sentences.zh: 用兵之始，可不慎歟，可不慎歟！

translations.literal: At the beginning of using arms—can one not be cautious? Can one not be cautious!
translations.idiomatic: At the outset of war—can one not be cautious? Can one not be cautious!
